capabilities: Explain ideas from an open note, a selection, or an attached note
Practise with interactive questions, hints, and feedback
Build objective-based learning plans and track progress
Review and approve proposed Markdown edits before applying them
Connect an external AI provider (AGY CLI, Codex CLI, or ChatGPT)
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian desktop 1.13.0+, no mobile). Stores conversations and progress locally, but note content in AI requests is sent to the selected provider; warns users to review provider permissions before using sensitive notes. Includes no model, credits, or provider subscription. Additional docs are linked externally (Providers & privacy, Docs, first-session guide).
problem: Obsidian stores notes but offers no way to be tutored on them, practise with feedback, or follow a structured learning plan built from them.

requires.name: AI provider (AGY CLI, Codex CLI, or ChatGPT plan)

summary: AI learning companion that explains note content, runs practice and review questions, and builds objective-based learning plans inside the vault.
